summary: Extends IS-IS to support optimal routing in a domain with two levels. It changes how routes are passed down from one level to the other so that a router can choose the best path, instead of being limited by route summarization between levels. It replaces RFC 2966 and extends the semantics of RFC 1195.

eli5.summary: A big country is split into regions, and normally the regions only share summaries. This lets them share more detail, so travelers can take the truly shortest road rather than a roundabout one.
